name: qa-warden
description: AI-written Playwright E2E tests. The healer can fix selectors, never assertions. AI-authored, Playwright-replayed E2E QA suite. Exploration/planner/ideation/generator/verifier/reviewer/healer subagents + oracle-defense skills + an AI-maintained page-object reuse layer (change a shared flow in one place; heal it once). AI authors specs, Playwright replays nightly at $0 LLM cost, AI triages only on failure. Run /qa-warden:init in a fresh project to stamp the runtime substrate.
